key_points: Q3 earnings beat estimates but stock plunged 11% to 52-week low on rising operating costs and liability concerns
Multiple analysts cut price targets (Truist to $180, Stephens to $190) citing claims costs
Market focused on cost pressures and freight market weakness rather than earnings upside
RXO integration progressing but not offsetting near-term margin headwinds
Technical selling and institutional liquidity flows amplifying decline
